newsitem.title: USA: Weis Markets sees new CEO for ailing unit.
newsitem.headline: Weis Markets sees new CEO for ailing unit.

text.p: Weis Markets Inc said Wendesday earnings in the first quarter of 1997, ended March 31, declined because of continuing problems at its SuperPetz subsidiary and that it is currently interviewing candidates to become chief executive of that subsidiary.
The company expects to name someone to that position shortly and, in the interim, management of Weis has taken over the day-to-day operations of SuperPetz.
Company officials could not be reached for further comment.
Earnings for the quarter declined 7.42 percent to $18.2 million, or $0.43 a share, from $19.7 million, or $0.46 a share in the year-earlier period.
